name: A11 Janus Vision Test
description: Après édition du runtime Janus, vérifie que le endpoint vision dev répond

then.command: powershell -Command "try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/dev/vision' -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{\"image\":\"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo=\",\"prompt\":\"test\"}' -TimeoutSec 25; Write-Host \"Janus: OK\" } catch { Write-Host \"Janus: $($_.Exception.Message)\" }"
